units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: H3 video for every clip. Idle v1: the gavel rises to the chest and returns, looping by video 88. Move v1: one gait cycle. Attack v1: wind-up, overhead smash to the ground, recovery; video 36-37 cut (green-tinted arm, smeared figure at the swing). Cast v1: a raised-palm command gesture, no spellcasting. Hit v2: starts rocked back and recovers, clean plate (v1 lost 50 frames to plate pulses). Defend v2: crouch and forearm guard over the visor, held; video 0-56 only, the plate pulsed after it. Death v1: forward collapse to a grounded corpse; video 22-23 cut (faceless, green tint).
